Welcome to the documentation for **Mayon**, a personal learning app built around a branchable chat graph. These docs are organized by intent: use the table below to pick the section that matches what you are trying to do.

| Section | Intent |
| ------- | ------ |
| [Tutorials](tutorials/getting-started.qmd) (learning-oriented) | Guided lessons — start here if you're new to Mayon |
| [How-to guides](how-to/providers.qmd) (task-oriented) | Step-by-step recipes for a specific goal |
| [Reference](reference/seams.qmd) (information-oriented) | Technical truth, scannable — contracts, rules, keys |
| [Explanation](explanation/architecture.qmd) (understanding-oriented) | Why Mayon is shaped the way it is |
| [Development notes](dev-notes/index.qmd) | Phase-by-phase build history from development (non-Diátaxis shelf) |
| [Decision history](history/index.qmd) | The narrative record of feature decisions and reversals (non-Diátaxis shelf) |
